assumptions: Budget calculated at ₹200 per guest for 100 people
Snacks and high-tea format instead of full meal

budget.notes: Bulk samosas, sweets, tea/coffee & soft drinks for 100
Society clubhouse, community terrace or park permit
Eco-friendly plates, paper cups, napkins & water jars
Portable bluetooth speaker, cordless mic & game props
Fairy lights, welcome banner and polaroid photo corner
Emergency buffer for extra snacks, ice, or trash bags

timeline.task: Reserve society clubhouse, park space, or common terrace
Circulate digital invite & RSVP poll on community chat
Negotiate package price with local halwai/caterer for 100 snack boxes
Source portable PA speaker, cordless mic, and build playlist
Purchase compostable plates, paper glasses, and paper napkins
Lock final RSVP count; confirm exact snack box quantity
Pick up tea/coffee premixes, cold drinks, ice boxes, and water
Setup food table, test sound system, welcome 100 guests, and coordinate cleanup

ask_before_booking: Can you deliver 100 freshly packed hot snack boxes at the exact time?
Are dipping chutneys, ketchup, and paper napkins included in the quote?
What is the bulk discount for 100 units paid in cash/UPI?
contract_must_include: Itemized count of pieces per box and delivery time commitment
Food freshness standard and hygiene packaging assurance
Delivery contact person and transport charges inclusion
vendors.payment_advice: Pay 30% advance, balance 70% upon verifying delivery count.
red_flags: Refusal to deliver on event day without heavy transport markup
Vague snack portion sizes or inconsistent food quality

ask_before_booking: Does the hall rental include chairs, trash cans, and power points?
What is the noise curfew and teardown cleaning expectation?
Are external caterers and tea brewing warmers allowed inside?
contract_must_include: Exact operational hours including setup and post-event cleanup
Conditions for full return of refundable security deposit
Permitted decibel limits and audio equipment guidelines
vendors.payment_advice: Pay required booking fee; ensure deposit receipt is documented.
red_flags: Unannounced electricity or post-party cleaning deductions
Strict unwritten rules that risk immediate cancellation

ask_before_booking: Does the speaker system include battery backup in case of power cuts?
Are 2 wireless microphones and connection cables provided?
How far does sound travel without causing distortion?
contract_must_include: Model specification, working cables, and spare microphone batteries
On-call replacement guarantee within 45 minutes of malfunction
Delivery and return timings clearly marked
vendors.payment_advice: Inspect sound output and mic clarity before full settlement.
red_flags: Supplying cracked cables or microphones with static noise
Demanding replacement cost for pre-existing equipment wear

ask_before_booking: Are plates sturdy and leak-proof for hot oily snacks?
Do you supply 20L purified water dispensers and pumps?
Can leftover sealed packs of disposables be returned for refund?
contract_must_include: Wholesale unit pricing for plates, glasses, and trash bags
Promised delivery date 48 hours prior to event
Return policy for undamaged unopened cartons
vendors.payment_advice: Buy from local wholesale market for maximum cash savings.
red_flags: Charging retail prices for 100+ bulk paper product quantities
Supplying flimsy single-use plastic liable to rip or spill

budget.notes: Location rental
Catering service

timeline.task: Submit local authority venue and sound permits

ask_before_booking: What is the exact venue hire time and setup window allowed?
Are external caterers, decorators, and alcohol allowed?
Is dedicated parking and wheelchair accessibility available?
contract_must_include: Exact access hours for setup, event, and teardown
Clear cancellation and weather rescheduling clause
Breakdown of cleaning fees, security deposit, and taxes
vendors.payment_advice: Standard advance 20-30%; hold balance until venue inspection.
red_flags: Demanding full payment upfront before contract signing
Vague noise curfew or overtime penalty fees not specified

ask_before_booking: Can you accommodate dietary needs (vegan, halal, gluten-free)?
What is your server-to-guest ratio and live counter setup?
Do you provide tasting sessions prior to final confirmation?
contract_must_include: Final per-plate pricing and minimum guest guarantee date
Food safety standards and waste cleanup responsibility
Staffing levels and equipment/chafing dish inclusions
vendors.payment_advice: Pay 25% deposit, 50% milestone, final 25% after the event.
red_flags: No certified kitchen or reluctance to provide a food tasting
Surprise add-on charges for cutlery, ice, or server uniforms

ask_before_booking: Who will be the specific lead photographer shooting on the day?
What is the turnaround timeline for edited high-res photos?
Do you have a backup camera body and backup memory card workflow?
contract_must_include: Exact shooting hours and overtime hourly rate
Deliverables count (raw photos, edited pictures, teaser video)
Copyright usage and print release permissions
vendors.payment_advice: Pay 20% retainer, remainder on raw preview delivery.
red_flags: No portfolio of full event galleries (only selective shots)
Refusal to commit named photographers in the written contract

ask_before_booking: Will flowers be fresh and seasonal, and how are they preserved?
Can you share 3D sketches or physical mockups of the stage?
What is your breakdown for teardown and cleanup timing?
contract_must_include: Itemized inventory of props, floral varieties, and backdrop specs
Teardown completion deadline to avoid venue penalties
Replacement clause if specific floral blooms are out of season
vendors.payment_advice: 30% advance on design approval, 50% on setup, 20% post event.
red_flags: Using other florists' photos without proof of own execution
Unwillingness to do a venue site walkthrough before quoting
